content:
The datasheet describes a single part number (LO-DM311T-DR8C) with one host/optical configuration: 1.6T DR8, 8×200G Ethernet, 1.6TAUI-8 C2M, 200G-PAM4. Alternate pool values (2 W dissipation, 1.6TAUI-8 without C2M, 8×100GAUI-1, 800/200 Gbps, DR4/DR8, stressed Rx −0.9 dBm) are either power states, naming variants, or test conditions—not separate selectable modes. No penalties were supplied in the input.
